fixes.replace: Perceptual Positions: 1) seeing from Self, 2) then seeing from Other, 3) then seeing from Witness, and 4) then seeing from Universal Heart.
fixes.with: Perceptual Positions: 1) seeing from Self (what do I feel from inside myself?), 2) then seeing from Other (if I sit inside the other person, what might they be feeling or protecting?), 3) then seeing from Witness (if I watched this from across the room, what would I notice?), and 4) then seeing from Universal Heart (what serves truth, love, boundaries, and the good of everyone involved?).

minor: what silence can mean is guidance to the reader, needing a new sentence of about 25 words outside the quoted prompt; the prompt already covers needing more time and resting
minor: the three missing prompts (daydream, anxiety, hidden truth) come to about 50 words
minor: what a presupposition is, 'Don't smuggle in obedience' and a referent for 'when it will happen' together need well over six words
minor: the missing 'Better' example alone is about 20 words
minor: the reason ('Done mechanically, it can feel like an inner eviction') needs about nine words, and dropping 'done mechanically' would overstate it
